behavior: Selects a candidate-ID pool based on bool(profile+0x121).
Iterates the pool and loads each candidate with 0x001A2FA0.
Gets the current career rank and filters each candidate through 0x001A3FBC.
Collects at most 10 eligible contract IDs.
If at least one is eligible, chooses one using RNG 0x0026E674.
Installs the chosen ID into the career live-contract slot through 0x0019FC10.
Runs 0x0019FAC4 and 0x001935E4 to perform the corresponding career/event setup.
Returns 1 on success and 0 when no eligible template was found.
automatic_offer_refresh.significance: The retail career already has an automatic eligible-offer fallback. Career Mode 2.0 can replace the phase-specific candidate pools and/or eligibility policy while preserving the downstream selected-contract and UI flow.
